segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some in dry climates or dealing with winter dehydration, consistently describe it as deeply hydrating without feeling heavy, sticky, or greasy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including ones managing rosacea or occasional over-exfoliation irritation, report it calms their skin with no redness, itchiness, or irritation.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with extremely oily skin reports it doesn't increase her oil production, though it doesn't reduce it either, and appreciates that it soothes without adding shine.
segments.combination: The combination-skin reviewer, whose skin leans dry, calls it perfect for her skin with zero stickiness and all-day hydration.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature skin, including a man in his 40s, report it calms dryness and tightness around the cheeks without leaving any shine, calling it a solid everyday investment rather than a dramatic transformation.

concerns.dehydration: This is the concern reviewers describe most, and overwhelmingly positively: reviewers switching from other toners, including ones dealing with dryness caused by tretinoin or alcohol-based products, report noticeably more hydrated, plumper, less tight-feeling skin, often within the first application.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness, irritation, or itchiness, including one managing rosacea who specifically credits it with calming her skin.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the ceramides with visibly supporting and repairing their skin barrier, describing skin that feels stronger and less reactive to dryness over time; no reviewer in this set reports barrier-related irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report it hasn't caused any breakouts, crediting the non-comedogenic, tested-on-acne-prone-skin formulation.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer with extremely oily skin reports the product doesn't make her oiliness worse, though it also doesn't reduce the oil that comes through over the day.

Milky texture slides off cotton pads, better applied with hands

extraits.titre: My Dry Skin Feels So Much Better
extraits.texte: I ordered this innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Toner because I like Korean skincare products very much. Overall, I have found them hydrating for my dry skin, and this toner is no different. The bottle arrived boxed, and the lid had a secure safety seal. This beautiful white toner is not as runny as other toners I've tried, especially if you give it a good shake before use. This can be poured into my hand and then applied gently to my face. I then like to wipe the remainder onto my hands, and they now feel nice and look a little younger, too. You can also use a cotton pad for application if you prefer. When applying, this toner soaks in quickly, makes my skin feel cool, and instantly moisturizes and hydrates. I love that there isn't any initial stickiness, just smooth, soft skin. This toner has a well-formulated ingredient list, particularly excellent for dry, dehydrated, sensitive, or mature skin, or for repairing a damaged skin barrier. Apparently, I am the poster girl (well, senior!) for this toner! I like the high hydration and skin-barrier support, using well-regarded, safe ingredients, as often seen in K-beauty. I'm glad I found this green tea milky toner, and for me, it is a good value for the price.

Being fully vested in Korean skincare but who usually keeps skincare simple, I like this innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk. innisfree products have always been a hit with my family, and enjoyed all of their Green Tea lineup over the last decade since we discovered this brand while traveling in South Korea. And as a mature male, I greatly appreciate that it has no scent and makes my skin feel good. The texture is light and absorbs quick, but it still gives enough moisture to make my skin feel comfortable throughout the day. I like that it isn't watery, rather a little thick so I can better control the amount coming out of the bottle. I use it after washing my face and shaving, and then before bed because my skin tends to get dry and tight, especially around my cheeks. Green tea and ceramide based skincare products are commonly used to help support hydration and strengthen the skin barrier, which is great because I am now in my 40s. But it should be good for all ages in my opinion. In summary, it calms my skin without being fragranced. It layers well with serums and sunscreen during the day and does not make my face look shiny. After a couple weeks, my skin definitely feels less dry and felt smoother overall. It may not be some dramatic miracle product, but for everyday hydration and keeping irritation down, it has been a solid replacement and great investment in my skincare routine.

I love this brand and their products! I have tried many of their items and from sunscreens to lotions, I really enjoy everything. This milk toner is very hydrating compared to other toners I've used. It looks very milky and shiny when squeezed out of the bottle, but it dries quite matte. It is lightweight and looks natural and not like you have anything smeared or dried onto your skin. There is no scent that I can detect, which is a plus. I use a retinol on my face each night before bed and this is soothing and helps with any flaking I might have in the morning. It is smooth under my sunscreen and makeup and has not created any issue with makeup lasting during the day. My skin is extremely oily and while this does not stop the oil coming through, it does not increase it as some toners can. It does not dry my skin out and I like it for the soothing effects and helping with my skins barrier.

This is a great toner. I have combination skin that tends to be on the dry side. This toner is perfect for my skin. I squeeze out the toner onto my fingers and then simply apply it. There's zero stickiness, and it easily absorbs. It also leaves my skin feeling hydrated and plump all day. I really love how healthy this makes my skin feel and look.
I have such sensitive, acne-prone skin and this product has done nothing but wonders! Makes my face look super glowy. Definitely worth it, I’m on my second bottle now.

extraits.titre: Lightweight but Very Hydrating – Great Value for the Price
extraits.texte: My skin gets very dry during the winter, and lately I’ve been dealing with a lot of dehydration under the surface. Using just a moisturizer didn’t feel like enough, so I decided to try this Innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Essence after a friend recommended it. The texture is milky and lightweight, and it spreads very smoothly over the skin. It absorbs nicely while still leaving my skin feeling soft and well hydrated. After applying it, my skin feels instantly more moisturized without feeling heavy or greasy, which makes it perfect for everyday use. I also like that it contains ceramides. My skin feels stronger and healthier, and it seems less sensitive to dryness than before. The subtle green tea scent is another plus—it’s fresh and pleasant without being overpowering. For the price, the performance is really impressive. It provides great hydration and makes my skin feel much more comfortable during dry seasons. I think it’s a great value and definitely worth trying.
